content_html:
Peru is known for its cultural and archaeological wealth, but it is also home to impressive beaches ideal for a relaxing or adventurous getaway. From the north with its warm sea to the south with its wild landscapes, these are the best spas you should visit.

1. Máncora – Paradise of Sun and Sand

Located in the Piura region, Mancora It is the most famous beach destination in Peru. Its golden sand, turquoise sea and vibrant nightlife make it a perfect place for national and international tourists. It is ideal for surfing, swimming with turtles in El Ñuro or enjoying a sunset in its luxurious beachfront hotels.

What to do in Mancora?

  • Surfing and water sports.
  • ATV rides around the area.
  • Relax in its exclusive resorts and spas.

2. Punta Sal – Relaxation and Exclusivity

Just a few kilometers from Máncora, Salt Point It is one of the most exclusive beaches in the country. Its waters are warm all year round and its calm waves make it ideal for families or couples looking for privacy. Many resorts offer luxury experiences with gourmet dining and beachfront spas.

Why visit Punta Sal?

  • Beaches with crystal clear waters and white sand.
  • Sunny weather almost all year round.
  • All-inclusive hotels with ocean views.

3. Vichayito – The Beach of Rest

If you are looking for tranquility away from the crowds, Vichayito It is the best option. Its waters are serene and its beach is perfect to disconnect. You can find accommodations in rustic bungalows or luxury tents with panoramic views of the ocean.

Recommended activities in Vichayito

  • Relax in a hammock with an ocean view.
  • Kayak or paddleboard in calm waters.
  • Romantic dinner on the beach under the stars.

4. Zorritos – The Northern Thermal Refuge

Located in Tumbes, little foxes combines natural beauty with hot springs. It is a less crowded destination but with a special charm. In addition to enjoying the sea, you can visit the famous Hervideros thermal baths, ideal for a day of relaxation.

Reasons to visit Zorritos

  • Warm waters perfect for swimming.
  • Natural thermal baths in the middle of nature.
  • Gastronomy based on fresh seafood.

5. Las Pocitas – A Hidden Treasure in Piura

Also known as Mancora Chico, The Pocitas It is a paradisiacal beach with small natural pools formed between the rocks during low tide. It is the ideal destination for those looking for a beautiful and less touristy place.

Not to be missed in Las Pocitas

  • Swim in natural pools.
  • Stay in a private beach house.
  • Walking along the shore at sunset.

6. Paracas – Beach and Nature on the South Coast

If you prefer a destination with natural beauty and wildlife, Paracas It is the best option. Its beaches like The Mine and scratch They have calm waters and impressive landscapes. Additionally, you can visit the Paracas National Reserve to see flamingos, sea lions and exotic birds.

Activities in Paracas

  • Tour to the Ballestas Islands to see marine fauna.
  • Sandboarding and buggy rides in the desert.
  • Bird watching in the National Reserve.

7. Red Beach – The Hidden Gem of Paracas

Within the Paracas National Reserve, the Red Beach It is one of the most impressive in Peru. Its red sand, contrasting with the blue sea and the golden cliffs, creates a unique landscape in the world. It is not suitable for swimming, but it is suitable for enjoying an unparalleled visual spectacle.

The best of Red Beach

  • Photography of surreal landscapes.
  • Ecological walks through the reserve.
  • Experience of peace and total disconnection.
